_doc: Curated, typed location edges for the Arden Vul map -- the TRUSTED layer. Authored by analysis of canon (session recaps, location pages, Vallium's ooc-planning route proposals), not by the local LLM. Each edge names its evidence basis. `reject` suppresses deterministic edges that are travel/staging artifacts (e.g. the party teleporting from their Beacon base), not real adjacency. Endpoints must be real vault/locations pages. Edges are two-way unless directed=true with a from/to.

teleport_network._doc: Thothian teleportation-circle network catalogued by Vallium (Greybrown), 2026-05-09. Any circle reaches any other by dialling the destination's six-colour code. Modelled as a hub: each circle <-> the hub. Circle names matching a vault location resolve to it; others are virtual nodes aliased by their code.
